content.title: National Vision (EYE) Stock Trades Up, Here Is Why
content.summary: Shares of optical retailer National Vision (NYSE:EYE) jumped 4.5% in the afternoon session after Morgan Stanley raised its price target on the company. The investment bank increased its target to $30.00 from a previous $26.00 while maintaining an "Equalweight" rating on the stock. The adjustment represented a more than 15% increase in the price target. This move came as the stock hit a new 52-week high, underscoring a period of strong performance.
